title: Mass scaling for dilations: M_{η(W)}(X′) = λ^{−m}M_W(X)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Then for every W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_{η(W)}(X') = ofReal(λ^{−m})·M_W(X) in [0,∞], where M_V(Y) = sup{ofReal(Y(ω)) : ω ∈ 𝒟^m(dom Y), tsupport ω ⊆ V, |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y} with |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm (SimonGMT massOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), X'.massOn (dilation a lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) * X.massOn W
